## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run check` pass
- [ ] A new or changed check has a test for the case it finds and a test for a case it must not find
- [ ] Practice ids and names match NIST SP 800-218 version 1.1
- [ ] The change does not print, store or send the value of anything that looks like a credential
- [ ] The README table and `docs/checks.md` are up to date
